AI Demand Forecast

Use planned production, expected consumers and historical consumption to predict demand and surplus.

Production Planning

Calculation basis: predicted demand uses the entered historical average consumption. Recommended production adds a small 2% planning buffer. Predicted surplus = planned production − predicted demand; avoidable overproduction = planned production − recommended production.

Processing Operations

Monitor processing efficiency, raw-material losses, machine downtime and energy usage.

Calculated automatically: production efficiency = output ÷ raw-material input × 100; raw-material loss = input − output; energy intensity = energy used ÷ output.
